text:
Both responses stay under 120 words (roughly 115 each) and share the same core facts: date, cost, funding, upgrades, prices, hours and opening-day events. Both also carry the same slightly compressed price line ("Unchanged for 2026-27" rather than "for the rest of the 2026-27 season").

**Accuracy:** Response B says "All programs and the water play area resume on opening day." The article names only lap swimming, aqua aerobics and learn-to-swim, so "all programs" overgeneralises. It also sits awkwardly beside swim school enrolments not opening until 20 October. Response A lists exactly the programs the article names and makes no such claim. A's other details check out against the text.

**Content kept:** B includes two details A drops: the adult change table and that the heated pool allows year-round lessons. These are useful but minor for a busy manager. A includes the specific list of programs, which is arguably more useful than B's blanket statement.

**Concision:** The two are about equal in length. B's bullets are easy to scan, but that doesn't outweigh its inaccuracy.

A is more accurate, which is the first criterion. B's extra details don't make up for the misleading "all programs" claim.

Verdict: A
